title: api-gateway: tune routing, streaming proxy buffers, and per-route payload limits for OpenAI compatibility
author: Sofia Patel
release_notes: Adjusts API gateway routing priorities and streaming proxy buffers for more stable OpenAI-compatible event streaming. Increases robustness for function/tool-calling payloads and structured output. No breaking changes to existing client contracts; opt-in config knobs exposed for Dedicated/Private customers.
description:
Context and motivation: Users integrating OpenAI-style event streams with tool/function calling reported intermittent stream stalls, reconnects during high-concurrency bursts, and occasional truncation of structured output aggregates. This PR updates routing priority heuristics, raises and caps streaming proxy buffer behavior, and tightens per-route payload size semantics to reduce memory spikes while preserving OpenAI compatibility.

What this changes (summary): - Routing: introduce route scoring that prefers local-region, model-variant, and SLA-tier matches; implement deterministic fallback order to avoid thundering when capacity constrained. - Streaming proxy: increase default chunk buffer to 256KB, add adaptive backpressure window based on downstream ACK latency, and ensure chunk boundaries align with OpenAI style "data: ...\n\n" event framing for compatibility with existing SDKs. - Payload size limits: add per-route soft/hard payload limits (default soft=256KB, hard=1MB) and a graceful error path that produces OpenAI-compatible error events when exceeding soft limits. - Observability: new metrics for stream_reconnects, stream_backpressure_ms, route_score, payload_limit_hits; dashboards and alerts updated. - Tests & benchmarks: e2e integration tests for streaming recovery, unit tests for router scoring, and a synthetic load benchmark showing 99th percentile reduction in stream stall latency.

Notes on compatibility: The OpenAI compatibility layer changes are additive: event framing behavior changed to align with OpenAI "data: [json]\n\n" delimiting, which fixes parsing differences across clients. Clients using raw chunk concatenation should still work; SDKs have been updated in parallel (see linked SDK PRs).

Checklist: - [x] Routing scoring implementation and deterministic fallback - [x] Streaming proxy buffer increase + adaptive backpressure - [x] Per-route payload soft/hard limits and graceful error events - [x] End-to-end tests and benchmark harness - [x] Documentation for new settings and upgrade notes - [x] Observability dashboards and alert thresholds

Commits (high-level): - 7c3b9f8: implement route scoring and deterministic fallback - 4a2d1b1: streaming proxy buffer and backpressure window - f9e8c3a: openai-compatible stream framing and parser tweaks - 1b7a2c0: add per-route payload limit config and enforcement - d3f2b11: tests, benchmarks, and docs updates

Files/areas changed (high level): - api-gateway/router/router.go (route scoring, fallback policy) - api-gateway/proxy/streaming_proxy.go (buffer/backpressure changes) - api-gateway/openai_compat/stream_parser.go (framing alignment) - api-gateway/config/routes.go (per-route limits, defaults) - observability/dashboards/streaming.json (new metrics) - docs/openai-compat.md (compatibility notes & upgrade guide) - tests/integration/streaming_recovery_test.go (e2e) - go.mod / go.sum (minor dependency bump for event framing lib)

Testing & CI: Initial CI run: lint failed (style in router.go). Fix applied in subsequent commit. Unit tests: all pass. Integration tests: flaky in CI (network flakiness) — rerun succeeded. Load benchmark: synthetic test with 2k concurrent streams showed stream reconnects reduced by ~82% and 99th percentile stream stall latency reduced by ~35% in typical workload.

Review conversation (high-level): - Alex Chen (review): "Can you add a feature flag to toggle the adaptive backpressure? On Dedicated we need a safety valve for memory behavior." - Sofia Patel (author): "Added config flag `streaming.adaptive_backpressure_enabled` with default true and documented override in routes config. Also added hard caps to ensure memory stays bounded." - Priya Natarajan (review): "Please ensure the OpenAI framing change is opt-in for older clients during rollout." - Sofia: "Framing change kept compatible; default behavior maintains existing concatenated chunk acceptance and prioritizes new framing when present. SDK PRs updated to emit framing by default." - Diego Martinez (approval): "Verified perf run locally and reviewed metrics; looks good."

Merge details: PR approved by reviewers and merged via squash. Merge commit: squash commit 9a8e7d4. Rollout plan: staged rollout to hosted API over 48 hours, Dedicated customers will see new config flags and can opt-in immediately.

Followups: - ENG-8420: add dynamic route weighting based on historical latency per model - ENG-8475: expose per-tenant stream metrics in Console
